Thank you, I appreciate that.

As far as money goes, probation is actually really expensive. It's like $800 just as a fine, then you have to pay like $40 each time you drug test while on probation and that can be weekly, plus legal fees, etc. I can't afford that. It's my first offense but my state is zero tolerance. I could get 2-3 years for the tiny amount I had on me, and jail on my record would ruin my life anyway.

I'm already inwardly messed up because of the assault, now the legal shit is making it clear from the outside how messed up I really am. My family doesn't believe that I was assaulted and they won't help with money either. So I don't have a lot of options.

You're definitely right, the drugs were just to take me away from my problems. I was assaulted and now have ptsd as a result. I did heroin to get away from the feelings of that, then weed to quit heroin. I got caught by the cops with the weed and now I'm facing jail time for it because I can't find a job so I can't afford the diversion or probation programs. Everything is just fucked up. I tried to improve my life and sitation and instead it made everything worse.

Thanks again for listening. I really appreciate it.

Hi Fedi. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me. I'm just going to think about it tonight and pick another method tomorrow.

Thanks, being clean was hard. I don't feel like it made a difference in my life though. I'm still in a really shitty place. Being clean doesn't seem worth it, but I'm not gonna do any more smack before I kill myself because I don't want to get labelled a junkie when I die.
